category_definitions.done: Done: defined score for the declared evaluated condition
category_definitions.queued: Queued for generation in the frozen runtime

definitions.done: At least one retained defined score for that setting's declared evaluated condition; does not mean every published case, native paper replication, high performance, or rationale validity.
definitions.queued: An exact frozen generation grant exists and no started record/progress is observed; an assignment in a planning registry is not an execution queue.
definitions.agent_work: The next listed step can be advanced under existing authority. It can include review and a later exclusion; it is not a promise that every case is eligible or all native artifacts exist.
definitions.impossible: Requires evidence that the whole setting cannot be pursued; missing exact native artifacts alone do not make a labelled available adaptation impossible.
definitions.counts: Each retained setting appears once. Development panels, OpenAI comparison conditions, archived BioReason settings and the historical 17145-case continuation are not additional settings.
definitions.runtime: Direct progress/completion contents are used; unsealed counts are lower bounds. Missing progress is unknown, not zero calls. No response filename counts used.

freshness.note: This tracker reads direct task evidence and does not promote the old controller or planning registry to live execution.
